gloss: one side, one of a pair

definitions.explanation: One item from a matched pair, such as one shoe, one glove, or one earring.
One side in a two-sided situation or relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片方|かたほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: One of my socks is missing.
I hold the luggage with one hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片方|かたほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I dropped one of my earrings.

examples.japanese: {片方|かたほう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いても→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't judge by hearing only one side of the story.

examples.japanese: ⟦けんか→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{片方|かたほう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦とは→とは：noentry⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: In a fight, it's not necessarily just one side that's at fault.

examples.japanese: {片方|かたほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦しても→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{片方|かたほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even if one side agrees, the other side may oppose.

notes:
{片方|かたほう} combines ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of two) + ⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧ (direction/side).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {片方|かたほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (one of the pair of...)
- {片方|かたほう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧ (only one side)
- {片方|かたほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|な}くす→無くす：01110_nakusu⟧ (to lose one of a pair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {片方|かたほう}: one of a pair (general)
- ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧: one (prefix, as in ⟦{片手|かたて}→片手：13462_katate⟧)
- ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧: one side; on the other hand
- ⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧: both (antonym)

USAGE:
- Often used for items that come in pairs: shoes, gloves, earrings, chopsticks
- Can also describe one party in a relationship or dispute
